title: Plugin tools page results and check query values
description: An agent using a plugin's search or listing tool gets one page of results and can ask for the next, and a knowledge sync reads every page, stopping at 200 a run and starting again when the system has forgotten a saved page. Every value a model puts into a plugin's query is checked against what the plugin allows and escaped, so it cannot change the query, and ops plugin test runs these tools the same way.
